claim: complete reproducible corpus used for CutRight v2; not an unbounded claim over all possible sources

sources.name: CutRight
sources.use: All current source; current external-provider assumptions are replaced by v2.

sources.name: Workspace capabilities
sources.use: Designer plus Brand, Brand Identity, Content, Writing, Social, QA, bounded-run, eval topology, and selected local assets.

sources.name: HeardRight
sources.license_posture: private user-owned; third-party model notices mandatory
sources.use: Copy the engine/core/platform source and only redistributable model assets into first-party CutRight packs.

sources.name: AutoShorts
sources.use: Reproduce project-library, onboarding, one-click-run, candidate-card, and progress behavior without copying source.

sources.name: Vox Director
sources.use: Absorb beat/shot structure, style bake-offs, A/B/C-roll, anti-monotony, and bounded async job semantics.

sources.name: Palmier Pro
sources.use: Reimplement typed editing actions, stable IDs, composited inspection, undo, variants, jobs, and skill catalog without copying Swift.

sources.name: llama.cpp
sources.use: Pinned local inference runtime; CutRight builds its own platform binaries.

sources.name: whisper.cpp
sources.use: Independent transcript/edge verifier; not transcript authority.

sources.name: Silero VAD
sources.use: Use exact ONNX model bytes with generated SHA-256 and no network fallback.

sources.name: MediaPipe
sources.use: May provide face/pose tracking only after telemetry-disabled, network-blocked qualification and per-model license closure.

sources.name: FFmpeg
sources.use: No GPL/nonfree flags; distribute configure line, notices, and corresponding source.

sources.name: Qwen3-4B
sources.use: Convert official safetensors to CutRight-owned GGUF; exact output hashes frozen by pack builder.

sources.name: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
sources.use: Convert official model and multimodal projector; ship only after all-target qualification.

sources.name: Qwen3.5-4B
sources.use: Not a shipping dependency until deterministic local runtime support passes the full matrix.

sources.name: Kokoro-82M v1.0
sources.use: Model hash is fixed; every voice file must have its own provenance and redistribution entry.

research.finding: Scene tiling and recurrent memory bridges for long streaming video.
research.consequence: Hierarchical scene memory, not whole-video prompt stuffing.

research.finding: Compact context memory plus detail memory retrieved by information density.
research.consequence: Two-tier evidence store and selective frame retrieval.

research.finding: Compressed long-term text with detailed short-term visual tokens.
research.consequence: Separate semantic summaries from high-resolution evidence.

research.finding: Selection, retrieval/perception, action, and reflection in multiple rounds.
research.consequence: Agent loop must retrieve, act, inspect, and revise.

research.finding: Segment-level retrieval and dynamic routing improve long-form contextual relevance.
research.consequence: Queries operate over indexed segments and retrieve bounded detail.

research.finding: Relevant and coverage-aware keyframe selection outperforms uniform sampling.
research.consequence: Evidence sampling must balance query relevance and coverage.

research.finding: Fine-grained audio-visual-language events and temporal boundaries.
research.consequence: Evidence graph has explicit audio/visual events and boundaries.

research.finding: Temporal hallucinations occur in actions, sequences, and scene transitions.
research.consequence: Truthfulness and chronology checks are first-class.

research.finding: Checklist-based audio-visual editing evaluation and iterative evaluator feedback.
research.consequence: Instruction, preservation, realism, edit-intent, and critic-revision axes.

research.finding: Target success, preservation success, and joint success.
research.consequence: Every edit is scored for requested change and untouched-content preservation.

research.finding: Structural fidelity, background consistency, naturalness, and temporal-spatial consistency.
research.consequence: Independent visual critic and multi-dimensional edit scoring.

research.finding: Fine-grained editing requires background preservation, temporal consistency, quality, and runtime metrics.
research.consequence: Object-level edit success is separated from non-target preservation.

research.finding: Video-to-video evaluation needs temporal alignment, structural fidelity, transformation quality, visual quality, and semantic alignment.
research.consequence: Release reports separate these dimensions instead of one aggregate score.

research.finding: Audio-visual inconsistency requires temporal grounding and conflict classification.
research.consequence: Critic tests include active-speaker, voiceover, scenic, and cross-modal conflict cases.

research.finding: Onset-aware conditioning improves event-level audio-visual synchronization.
research.consequence: Transient alignment is evaluated at event/onset level.
Audio generation and SFX placement use frame/event alignment evidence.
